checks: Defconfig expands with exactly the intended LCM name and no unrelated donor LCM selected as primary.
All imported drivers have Kconfig symbols and Makefile objects reachable from the selected defconfig.
DTS contains no duplicate devices at I2C0:0x3e, I2C0:0x5d, I2C1:0x0c, I2C1:0x18, I2C1:0x53, I2C1:0x63, I2C1:0x6a, I2C3:0x6b, or I2C4:0x28.
Camera sensor list contains imx278mipiraw and ov8856jslmipiraw only after real source implementations are present.
Battery/charger profile is Meizu-specific, not Huawei donor-only.
Kernel image builds without undefined references from imported LCM, ALS/PS, camera, flashlight, charger, NFC, or fingerprint objects.
DTB builds without unresolved phandles, duplicate unit-address warnings, or pinctrl reference errors.
No imported driver uses incompatible post-3.18 APIs without adaptation.
No driver registration is hidden behind an unselected project macro.
Display initializes with ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd evidence-confirmed sequence.
Touch probes on I2C0 address 0x5d and emits input events.
BMA253, LTR578, and ST480 probe on I2C1 at 0x18, 0x53, and 0x0c.
BQ24157 charger probes on I2C1 address 0x6a and reports safe charge state.
MT6311 probes or is initialized through the expected PMIC path.
TPS65132 bias is enabled before panel DSI init and disabled in the correct suspend order.
NFC MT6605 probes on I2C4 address 0x28 and exposes expected userspace node.
Sunwave fingerprint exposes expected userspace node and interrupt works.
Camera sensors read expected IDs for imx278 and ov8856jsl.
AW3643 torch/flash current limits match stock values.
Wi-Fi and audio are tested only after chip identities are recovered.

risks.details: Using ili9881c/hx8394f donor panels instead of ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd can produce black display or wrong bias sequencing.
Huawei6750 DTS/defconfig may compile but encode wrong GPIOs, regulators, camera ordering, charger profile, and audio routing for Meizu M6.
BQ24157 support is not proven by the listed files. Wrong charge current or thermal policy can cause no-charge, overcurrent, or thermal faults.
imx278 header presence does not mean the sensor implementation exists. Stock HAL may fail if sensor order or driver name differs.
BMA253 and ST480 may probe but report wrong axes if donor layout values are retained.
Sunwave source exists, but the profile lacks bus type and GPIO evidence.
No Wi-Fi or audio hardware identities were supplied; enabling donor defaults may not work and can hide missing firmware or codec routing issues.
NFC, fingerprint, camera, flashlight, and sensors must expose device nodes and names expected by stock Meizu userspace.
